implementation_notes.target_scale: targets divided by s = sqrt(sum w ||Pi/eps||_F^2 / 4) of the training cases (Paper 1/R0 convention); predictions multiplied back
implementation_notes.loss: sum_n w_n ||f_n - Pi_n/s||_F^2 over the full 3x3 tensor, w normalised to sum 1; A-soft adds lambda * sum_n w_n (tr f_n)^2
implementation_notes.early_stopping_loss: data term on the inner validation case, float32, patience 200, max 5000 epochs
implementation_notes.selection_metric: inner-validation E_Pi of the full tensor, float64 with weights cast
implementation_notes.primary_metric: E_Pi of the full symmetric tensor (13/23 components included: DNS value 0); Paper 1's 4-component metrics also stored
implementation_notes.non_finite_policy: a fit whose loss becomes non-finite stops; during tuning the trial is recorded as FAIL and scored +inf for every model alike; a final refit that fails is retried once with identical settings and then recorded as failed
implementation_notes.A_aug: 8 random rotations of every training sample (inputs and targets rotated), original frame not included; scalers fitted on the augmented inputs; rotation draws seeded by the training seed
implementation_notes.A_soft: M3 without dev(.); isotropic-limit subtraction kept
